example.question: Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations which show their hematoclit level exceeded the normal range.
example.evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)); patient with two or more laboratory examinations refers to COUNT(ID) > 2; hematoclit level exceeded the normal range refers to HCT > = 52;
example.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID IN ( SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE HCT >= 52 GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ID) >= 2 )

generation.sql:

FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(l.ID) > 2;

example.question: Among the posts with views ranging from 100 to 150, what is the comment with the highest score?
example.evidence: views ranging from 100 to 150 refers to ViewCount BETWEEN 100 and 150; comment with the highest score refers to Text where MAX(Score);

example.question: What is the percentage of loan amount that has been fully paid with no issue.
example.evidence: Loan paid with no issue means contract finished, no problems; status = 'A' means contract finished, no problems; Percentage of accounts by condition = [(total(amount) & condition) / (total amount)] * 100%
example.gold_sql: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100) / SUM(amount) FROM loan

generation.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS percentage FROM loan;
